name: Engineer Workstation
hint: Developer comfort and the security baseline: long paths, file extensions, hidden files. WSL 2, Hyper-V, Sandbox and Docker stay compatible.
description: For development PCs. Turns on Win32 long paths, shows file extensions and hidden files, adds End task to the taskbar, turns PowerShell 7 telemetry off and keeps the full security baseline. Nothing here touches virtualization, so WSL 2, Hyper-V, Windows Sandbox and Docker keep working, and no services are disabled. Developer Mode, Dev Drive and the developer cleaner rules are guidance, because each is your decision.
guidance: Enable WSL 2, Hyper-V or Windows Sandbox in Toolkit > Features (Docker Desktop needs WSL 2).

Put repositories and package caches on a Dev Drive: Microsoft Defender scans it in performance mode, the supported way to speed up builds without antivirus exclusions (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/dev-drive/).

Developer Mode (Settings > System > Advanced) allows symbolic links without elevation and loose-file app deployment; Microsoft warns that it lowers security, so turn it on yourself only if you need it.
Clear package caches with the developer cleaner rules: .\iGWindowsTuner.ps1 -Clean -Scan -CleanLevel Advanced -IncludeOptIn (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip, NuGet and VS Code caches).
